map.到货品控：叶菜/水果/鲜肉/水产到库时按温度、外观、气味、质地四项 10 分制打: Incoming quality control: score temperature, appearance, smell and texture for leafy vegetables, fruit, fresh meat and aquatic products on a 10-point scale at receipt, auto-grading freshness and estimating remaining shelf life.
map.冷链核查：温度超标（如叶菜>2℃、水产>0℃）会显著扣温度分并缩短预估货架期，用: Cold chain verification: temperature excursions (e.g. leafy vegetables >2℃, aquatic products >0℃) cut the temperature score sharply and shorten the estimated shelf life, used to judge whether the cold chain has been broken.
map.陈列管理：结合已存放时长，对临期（剩余货架期偏短）商品优先促销或下架，降低报损。: Display management: combine time in storage and prioritise promotions or delisting for near-expiry goods (short remaining shelf life) to reduce write-offs.
map.评分与 GB/T 31081 的关系？: What is the relationship between the score and GB/T 31081?
map.本工具温度阈值与 shelf 参考 GB/T 31081《生鲜农产品配送服务规范: The temperature thresholds and shelf references here follow the cold-chain bands in GB/T 31081 "Fresh Produce Distribution Service Specification", but the composite score is a demonstration model — real acceptance should follow the company's QC standards and sensory judgement.
map.剩余货架期为何随温度骤降？: Why does remaining shelf life fall so sharply with temperature?
map.温度系数 tf 在超标后从 1/0.8 跌到 0.3，且已存放时长持续消耗 ms: The temperature coefficient tf drops from 1/0.8 to 0.3 once limits are exceeded, and time in storage keeps consuming ms; the longer the cold chain is broken the shorter the remaining shelf life, so test on arrival and store cold to preserve it.
